evidence: User asked (2026-10-14) for the Whiplash to work like ULTRAKILL's and also grapple blocks. Decompiled HookArm: the throw stops on environment layers (6,7,8,16,18,24) with sparks, and catches enemies only on layers 11/12 (ULTRAKILL enemies carry a layer-12 hook trigger); light enemy types (Filth, Stray, Schism, Soldier, Drone, Streetcleaner) are pulled to the player at 60 u/s through their Rigidbody, any other enemy pulls the player to it at 60 u/s and adds hard damage; anything else on layer 11/12 without an EnemyIdentifier is caught as a plain anchor that pulls the player to it. Minecraft mob hitboxes were only on layer 10, so the hook passed through them. Mob size: width*width*height in blocks; 2.0 puts zombies, skeletons, spiders, cows and endermen in the light group and iron golems, ravagers, horses, hoglins, polar bears and the warden in the heavy group. 30 blocks/s is ULTRAKILL's 60 units/s at 2 units per block. The anchor sits half a block out from the hit face so the native line-of-sight checks pass and the player reaches it against the wall.
